description_zh: 在云安全态势管理自定义检查项功能中，查询检查项分类设置中的归属标准、归属条例或归属章节
name: ListCheckPolicies

parameters.help_en:
Policy type of the custom check item rule:
STANDARD: New standard
REQUIREMENT: New requirement
SECTION: New section
parameters.help_zh:
自定义检查项规则的策略类型：
STANDARD：新增归属标准
REQUIREMENT：新增归属条例
SECTION：新增归属章节
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en: ID of the newly added classification setting
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: Name of the newly added classification setting
parameters.name: policy_show_name

parameters.help_en:
ID of the associated parent policy.

(The specific dependency relationship from low to high is: Section -> Requirement -> Standard)
parameters.help_zh:
关联的上级策略ID。
      
（具体的依赖关系从低到高依次为章节->条例->标准）
parameters.name: dependent_policy_id

parameters.help_en: The types of policies to be queried (default queries both custom and system predefined policies)
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的策略类型（默认查询自定义和系统预定义策略）
parameters.name: check_types

parameters.help_en:
Name of the associated major policy category (required when PolicyType is STANDARD):
AISPM: AI Configuration Management (AI-SPM)
IDENTITY_PERMISSION: Identity and Permission Management (CIEM)
RISK: Security Risk
COMPLIANCE: Compliance Risk
parameters.help_zh:
关联的策略大类的名称（PolicyType取值为STANDARD时为必填）：
AISPM：AI配置管理（AI-SPM）
IDENTITY_PERMISSION：身份权限管理(CIEM)
RISK：安全风险
COMPLIANCE：合规风险
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: Number of check item information entries displayed per page during pagination. The default value is 50, indicating 50 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的检查项信息的数量。默认值为50，表示每页显示50条检查项信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number from which to start displaying the query results. The starting value is 1. The default value is 1, indicating that the display starts from the 1st page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
Language type for request and response messages, with a default value of zh. Possible values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

PageInfo.description_en: Paging information for the query results

Count.description_en: The number of data entries displayed on the current page when performing a paginated query
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The current page number displayed in the result
CurrentPage.description_zh: 返回结果中显示的当前页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of data entries per page when performing a paginated query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of policies queried
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的策略的总条数

items.description_en: Details of the custom policy data
items.description_zh: 自定义策略的数据详情

CheckType.description_en:
Source type of the security check item:
CUSTOM: User-defined
SYSTEM: Predefined by the security platform
CheckType.description_zh:
态势感知检查项的来源类型：
CUSTOM：用户自定义
SYSTEM：态势感知平台预定义

DependentPolicyId.description_en:
The ID of the associated higher-level policy.

(The specific dependency relationship, from low to high, is Section -> Requirement -> Standard)
DependentPolicyId.description_zh:
关联的上级策略ID。

（具体的依赖关系从低到高依次为 章节->条例->标准）

PolicyType.description_en:
Policy type of the custom check item rule:
STANDARD: Standard policy type
REQUIREMENT: Requirement policy type
SECTION: Section policy type
PolicyType.description_zh:
自定义检查项规则的策略类型：
STANDARD：标准策略类型
REQUIREMENT：条例策略类型
SECTION：章节策略类型

Type.description_en:
Name of the associated major policy category (required when PolicyType is STANDARD): 
AISPM: AI Configuration Management (AI-SPM) 
KISPM: Kubernetes Configuration Management (KSPM) 
IDENTITY_PERMISSION: Identity and Permission Management (CIEM)
RISK: Security Risk
COMPLIANCE: Compliance Risk
Type.description_zh:
关联的策略大类的名称（PolicyType取值为STANDARD时为必填）：
AISPM：AI配置管理（AI-SPM）
KISPM：Kubernetes配置管理(KSPM)
IDENTITY_PERMISSION：身份权限管理(CIEM)
RISK：安全风险
COMPLIANCE：合规风险

RequestId.description_en: ID of the current call request, generated by Alibaba Cloud as a unique identifier for the request, which can be used for troubleshooting and problem localization
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
